question: A handball team consists of _______ players.
solution:
The correct answer is __**7**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Handball is also known as team handball 
 
• It is played by passing a ball using their hands with the aim of throwing it into the goal of the other team.
 
• A standard match consists of two periods of 30 minutes and the team that scores more goals wins.

Explanation:__

Handball team:

__
 
• It is a team sport
 
• It is played between two teams of seven players each (six outcount players and a goalkeeper)

Handball (Dimensions):

 
• According to IHF(International Handball Federation) rule-

 
 
• Length-40m
 
• Breadth-20m
 
• Half diagonal- 28.28
 
• Full diagonal-44.72.
 
• The inner dimension of goal post- 2X3m 
 
• The full dimension of goal post- 2.08 X 3.16m 
 
• Centerline- 20 m from any end line.
 
 

Thus, there are 7 players in a handball team.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• This sport is usually played indoors, but outdoor variants exist in the form of field handball and beach handball.
 
• The game is fast and high-scoring, professional teams now typically score between 20 to 35 goals each, though lower scores were not common until a few decades ago.
 
• Body contact is permitted.
 
• No protective equipment is mandated but players may wear soft bands, pads, and mouth guards.
